newDelivery.title: New delivery

clients.subtitle: Manage the patient database and their delivery instructions.

clients.selectHint: Select a patient to see their delivery instructions.

clients.complianceReminder: Reminder: do not include medical, pharmaceutical, or diagnostic information here.
clients.deactivateConfirmBody: {name} will no longer appear when creating a delivery. Past delivery history is preserved.
clients.newSubtitle: Save a patient so deliveries can be created for them.

drivers.title: Drivers
drivers.subtitle: Manage driver access to the mobile app.
drivers.name: Name
drivers.deactivateBody: {name} will be signed out of the mobile app and will lose access to patient information immediately.
drivers.activeOrders: {count, plural, one {# active delivery is} other {# active deliveries are}} still assigned to them.
drivers.empty: No driver has joined your organization yet.
drivers.emptyHint: Generate an invite code to add one.

invites.title: Invite codes
invites.subtitle: Drivers enter this code to join your organization.
invites.revokeRedeemed: This code has already been redeemed and cannot be revoked. To remove the driver's access, deactivate them in the driver list.
invites.emptyHint: Generate one to add your first driver.

settings.title: Settings
settings.pharmacyIntro: The pharmacy address is where driver routes start and end, and the origin every arrival estimate is measured from.
settings.pharmacyAddressHint: Pick a suggestion to store the coordinates. A hand-typed address is kept, but leaves routes with no starting point.
settings.pharmacyNoDepot: No coordinates stored: routes do not start from the pharmacy and arrival estimates are unavailable.
settings.pharmacySaved: Address saved. Routes will now start from the pharmacy.
settings.pharmacySavedUnlocated: Address saved, but without coordinates: routes will not start from the pharmacy.
settings.passwordWarning: Changing your password ends every one of your sessions, including this one. You will have to sign in again.
settings.passwordTooShort: The password must be at least 12 characters.
settings.passwordMismatch: The two passwords do not match.
settings.passwordSameAsCurrent: The new password must be different from your current one.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Delivery management dashboard
login.accountDisabled: This account has been deactivated. Contact your administrator.
login.throttled: Too many attempts. Try again in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
login.genericError: Unable to sign in right now. Please try again.
login.idleNotice: You were signed out after 30 minutes of inactivity.
login.expiredNotice: Your session expired. Please sign in again.
login.passwordChangedNotice: Your password has been changed. Sign in with your new password.
login.driverBody: This dashboard is for pharmacy administrators. Drivers use the mobile app.

idle.title: Still there?
idle.body: For safety, your session will close in two minutes. Shared workstations should not stay signed in unattended.

errors.ORDER_INVALID_TRANSITION: The delivery's state changed in the meantime. Here is where it stands now.
errors.ORDER_NOT_EDITABLE: This delivery can no longer be edited: a driver already has the package.
errors.CLIENT_INACTIVE: This patient is deactivated. Reactivate them before creating a delivery.
errors.DRIVER_INACTIVE: This driver is no longer active.
errors.UNAVAILABLE: The delivery service is unreachable. Try again in a moment.
errors.ORDER_NOT_READY: This order has not been declared ready yet.
errors.ORDER_ALREADY_TERMINAL: This delivery is finished and can no longer be changed.
errors.FAILURE_REASON_REQUIRED: A reason is required for a return.

calendar.subtitle: The month at a glance. Scheduled orders are not visible to drivers yet.

address.located: Address located — this delivery will be included in the route.
address.notLocated: Address not located. This delivery will be added at the end of the route.

routes.degraded: Route unchanged: the optimization service is unavailable.
routes.degradedBanner: This is the previous order, not the optimizer's. The service was unavailable.
routes.timeRangeHint: The range applies only to stops with no promised time. A delivery already promised to a patient keeps its time.
routes.ungeocoded: {count, plural, one {# address is not located} other {# addresses are not located}} — {count, plural, one {it will be added} other {they will be added}} at the end of the route.
